translations.1: Morning, the mist outside the mountain gate hadn't dissipated.
translations.10: Sister Zeng, Elder Qin is calling you to the ward, there are you and Master Wanxiu here.
translations.11: Okay. Miss Chou is awake, immediately come and call me.
translations.12: Wanyan Jing scratched his head and turned to run towards the foot of the mountain.
translations.13: Xiè Xuán stood at the entrance of the hall, her sword was not drawn, but the light flickered for a moment.
translations.14: Qin Elder, how have you been? I have come on the order of the pavilion master to take three shares of qi stone.
translations.15: Three-tenths? Qi stones are the sect's hard-earned savings, when do outsiders get to take them?
translations.16: The ward is all cracked, qi stones won't be safe if they're in your hands. I'll come back in three days.
translations.17: 解玄 coldly smiled, turned around and walked away without looking back.
translations.18: Said three days is three days, never breaks his word.
translations.19: Qin Elder stroked his beard and looked at the unconscious Chou Shuang on his mat.
translations.2: Yunzhou, you finally returned. Did you bring enough qi stones?
translations.22: This is the eye formation order. Holding it will keep your path.
translations.23: Yuè Chuān put the medicine pouch into Yúnzhōu's arms, and then quietly reminded him of a few more things.
translations.24: At the mountain entrance, Wan Sita Jing delivered a蓑衣 (蓑衣 -蓑衣).
translations.25: Thank you, Wan Sita Senior Brother.  Còu Gu'er (仇姑娘 - 仇姑娘) woke up, please say thank you for her.
translations.26: Shàn Yúnzhōu nodded and tucked the array command close to his body.
translations.27: In the hall, Choushuang slowly opened her eyes.
translations.28: 醒了就好。你昏了一整天,别乱动 ▼
translations.29: Cou Fang struggled to sit up and looked at the torn curtain of heaven outside the window.
translations.3: Brought three bags, they are all the best from the back mountain.
translations.30: Without anyone noticing, the letter in her sleeve was sealed with the seal of Xie Xuan.
translations.4: The ward cracked again last night, and Elder Qin didn't sleep all night.

translations.8: Wan Yi Qi Jing backed up and rushed into the main hall with the unconscious woman, and the iron badge on his waist was engraved with: Qiushuang.
translations.9: The injury isn't serious, just that the spiritual energy has been exhausted. Give her one Return Spirit Pill.
